Import from Remote Desktop Manager; Reach in Czech.

- Sessions: import RDP, SSH and VNC hosts from a Devolutions Remote
  Desktop Manager export (.rdm or .json), with their folders,
  usernames and SSH gateways. Passwords are never imported.
  Contributed by @rsipka (#167).
- Czech translation, the tenth language. Contributed by @rsipka (#168).

Full details: https://github.com/alexandrosnt/Reach/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
